messages:
noah: kicking off tiny rollout for llm-route v3 under flag `ff.llmroute.v3` — plan: 0% -> 4% over 12m, canary: us-east. deploy-bot: rollout created id=rb-6240 (link: https://releases/internal/rb-6240)

maya: ack. kim, can you pin APAC to v2 for 40m while we watch?

kim: yep running: `deploy-bot pin-cohort --cohort=apac --service=llm-route --version=v2 --ttl=40m`
deploy-bot: cohort pin applied (pin_id=pin-624A)

alex: dashboards set: p50/p95 latency, 5xx-rate, kv-cache-miss-rate. alerts: p95>1600ms or 5xx>0.7%

noah: starting ramp now. deploy-bot: traffic -> 2% (canary us-east)

maya: short bump in 502s at 01:21 UTC, 0.2% -> 0.9% in ~5m, mostly long-context requests (>700 tokens).

noah: pausing ramp. deploy-bot: pause rb-6240 (reason: canary 5xx spike reported)

kim: looking at traces — v3 workers hit a cache eviction storm for multi-turn requests; OOM restarts on a subset of nodes.
alex: recommendation: drain canary workers and fail back to v2 for canary cohort, keep APAC pin.

noah: agree. deploy-bot: initiating partial rollback (canary subset) rb-6240 -> v2
deploy-bot: partial rollback complete — canary reverted to v2, apac pin remains (pin-624A)

maya: removing global canary pin. kim: removed. leaving APAC pin until RCA done.

alex: filing ISSUE-8899 with traces and memory timelines. release note snippet: "v3 canary paused; partial rollback to v2 for canary due to cache-eviction OOMs under long multi-turn contexts; APAC pinned to v2 while we investigate."

noah: next steps: kim to open perf bug and attach heap/dump, alex to add release-note and ticket updates, maya to schedule narrow re-run after patch (1% traffic, max_ctx=512). :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: ticket linked https://issues/internal/ISSUE-8899 (status: investigating)

maya: ping me on ISSUE-8899 when a fix candidate is staged; will coordinate smoke run and customer comms.

noah: closing thread; follow-ups in ISSUE-8899.
